task: distinguish a claim paired with its source evidence block from the same claim paired with another owner's evidence block in the same domain and split
labels: automatically constructed silver labels, not human gold labels
calibration: threshold selected on validation by maximum F1, ties resolved toward the higher threshold
test_policy: test is evaluated once after code and protocol registration
uncertainty: 1000-sample owner-level bootstrap 95% interval for full-pair F1 and AUROC
prohibited_claim: results may not be presented as performance on independently human-annotated data
